result.topic_en: Gauss expands auxiliary quantities for near-parabolic orbits (A, k, y, P, Q, N, R as series and continued fractions in z = tan²½E or −tan²½F) so that a second table with argument A can directly give log tan½v.
result.transcription:
53 II.
Litt. G.

IV. Die Operationen in III. können durch den Gebrauch einer zweiten Tafel abgekürzt werden die für das Argument $A$ sogleich $\log\frac{2\tan\frac12 E}{\sqrt A}$ oder $\log\frac{2\tan\frac12 F}{\sqrt{-A}}$ angibt zu dem man bloss $\frac12(\log [-\pm-] A)$ [-+-] $\log 2+\log\sqrt{\frac{1+e}{1-e}}$ [-zu addiren-] oder $\log\frac{5(1+e)}{1+9e}\cdot\tan\frac12 w$ zu addiren braucht um $\log\tan\frac12 v$ zu erhalten.

Wenn man $\tan\frac12 E^2$ oder $-\tan\frac12 F^2 = z$ setzt so stehen obige Grössen so

$A = 4z\frac{1-\frac35 z+\frac{1.3}{5.7}zz-\frac{1.3.5}{5.7.9}z^3\ldots}{1+\frac35 z-\frac35\cdot\frac15 zz+\frac35\cdot\frac{1.3}{5.7}z^3\ldots}$ [?]

$k=\frac{\{1-\frac{6}{15}z+\frac{7}{25}zz-\frac{8}{35}z^3+\}^{\frac32}}{\{1-\frac65 z+\frac97 zz-\frac{12}{9}z^3+\}^{\frac12}}$

$\frac{t^m-\frac{m.m+1}{2.2m+1}t^{m+2}+\frac{m.m+1.m+2.m+3}{2.4.2m+1.2m+3}t^{m+4}-\text{etc.}}{\tau^m-\frac12\cdot\frac{2m}{2m+1}\tau^{m+2}+\frac{1.3}{2.4}\frac{2m.2m+2}{2m+1.2m+3}\tau^{m+4}-\text{etc.}}=2^m$ [?]

$A=4z\cdot\frac{1-\frac65 z+\frac97 zz-\frac{12}{9}z^3+}{1-\frac{6}{15}z+\frac{7}{25}zz-\frac{8}{35}z^3+}=4z\frac{P}{Q}$

$15Q+Pz=15(1-\frac13 z+\frac15 zz-\ldots)=15R$
$15Q-9Pz=15(1-z+zz-\ldots)$

$y=\frac85\frac{\{\frac1{35}z^2-\frac3{63}z^3+\frac6{99}z^4-\frac{10}{143}z^5+\text{etc}}{1-\frac6{15}z+\frac7{25}zz-\frac8{35}z^3+\text{etc.}}$

Setzt man $4z=\frac{A}{1-\frac15 A+y}$
so wird $y=\frac1{350}AA+\frac1{4200}A^3+\frac{237}{10780000}A^4+\frac{3593}{1681680000}A^5+$
$+28571.4\,AA$
$+2380.9\,A^3$
$+220.0\,A^4$

$=\frac{\frac1{10}(1-\frac3{20}A)(1+\frac1{20}A+y)AA}{(1-\frac15A+y)^3}\{\frac1{35}-\frac3{63}z+\frac6{99}zz-$
$1{,}622(1+z)$ [?] $=25{,}6\,\frac{33(1+z)^2}{(1-z)^6}$ [?]
$=\frac1{35}(1-z)^5(1-\frac53z+\frac{25}{11}z^2-\frac{125}{429}z^3+\frac{490}{143}z^4)$ [?]
$\frac1{35}\frac{(1-z)^5}{(1+z)^2}$ [?]

$=\frac{(\frac45-\frac{12}{35}N)zz}{(10+12z+\frac{12}{5}zz)+(\frac{18}{7}z+\frac{12}{5}zz)N}=\frac{(\frac13-\frac17N)zz}{(z+3{,}94337567)(z+1{,}05662433)+z(z+1{,}07142857)N}$

wo $N=\frac{1}{1+\frac{\frac{16}{63}z}{1+\frac{\frac{25}{99}z}{1+\frac{\frac{36}{143}z}{1+\text{etc}}}}}=\frac{1-\frac{70}{7.9}z+\frac{105}{9.11}zz-\frac{140}{11.13}z^3}{1-\frac{30}{5.7}z+\frac{45}{7.9}zz-\frac{60}{9.11}z^3}=\frac{1-2\cdot\frac59z+3\cdot\frac{5.7}{9.11}z^2-4\cdot\frac{5.7.9}{9.11.13}z^3}{1-2\cdot\frac37z+3\cdot\frac{3.5}{7.9}zz-4\cdot\frac{3.5.7}{7.9.11}z^3}$
$1+3\cdot\frac19\,\zeta\ldots$ [?]
$\frac53\;\frac3{13}\;\frac65\;\frac7{15}\;\frac7{17}\;\frac86\;\frac2{19}$ [?]

$A=\frac{4z(1+y)}{1+\frac45z}$

Es sei $\frac{2\sqrt\zeta}{1-\zeta}=\sqrt z$
$\zeta=\frac{-1+\sqrt{1+z}}{1+\sqrt{1+z}}=\frac{z}{(1+\sqrt{1+z})^2}$

$=\frac{\sqrt{(1-\frac15A+y)}}{(1-\frac3{20}A)(1+\frac1{20}A+y)}$
